data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old High German word 'hera' meaning 'lord' or 'master', and 'le' meaning 'little'. In Germanic culture, the name Herrle was given to children who were expected to inherit leadership roles in their families or communities. The name Herrle carries the meaning “Little master, ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Herrle usually hope their child will grow to embody little master, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
